M-Vsynth2

Synth2 (the open-source Synth1) on the M-VAVE FM-1. Every patch parameter is on a page; the number is its .sy1 index.

Buttons

LFO EDIT ENV SEL FX GLOa section: the first press opens its page, the next steps through them (GLO ends on GLOBAL: MIDI CH, VOICES, TEMPO; then GLOBAL 2/2: THEME, COLOUR)
ARPtap: the arp on / off; hold: the ARP page
KNOB 1..4the page's four columns (HOME: FREQ, RES, AMOUNT, GAIN)
SELECTthe column last turned, one step at a time
ALGORITHMevery page in turn
PRESETSthe program (slots that hold a patch)
HOMEthe home screen
SEQthe bank browser (K1 the bank; turning plays the slot)
SAVEthe save screen (K1 bank U1..U8, K2 slot, K3 the cursor in the name, K4 or SELECT its character); SAVE again writes, any other button leaves
OCT- OCT+the octave

MIDI CC map

Ours, not Synth1's (Synth1 has none of its own): every knob sends and receives on these. CC 0 bank select (0 FACTORY, 1..8 U1..U8), CC 1 the INIT patch's mod-wheel route, 64 sustain, 120 / 123 all off. A patch's two CTRL routes act as well.
